name: Paqy
message: Hey, what are you spacing out for?

name: Paqy
message: You're gonna be in trouble when push comes to shove.

name: Synn
message: I wonder why she suddenly got so mad?
Azel stood in the dim darkness, staring down at his feet.

name: Synn
message: That's the spot where Miss Melilot was crouching the other day.

name: Paqy
message: No doubt about it. I thought she hadn't been showing her face lately, and here he is wandering around at this hour.

name: Synn
message: No, he's actually been around the whole time--he just ignores me whenever I try talking to him every day......
As we held our breath and watched, Azel muttered under his breath.
The dead-silent night air carried his murmur crystal clear.

name: Synn
message: He said... 'it's been destroyed,' right? And 'an enemy,' too.

name: Paqy
message: I read his lips, so I'm sure of it.
Azel said nothing more, and slipped away without a sound.

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah. He's reeking of that angel stink」
